lines.trans: Goodness, are there no sausages in here?
Because you told me to buy crackers.
Just because someone says buy crackers, do you really buy only crackers?
Some rookies catch my drift right away and bring beef jerky, gum, and everything.
Even forgetting everything else, leaving out sausages went too far.
Forget it. And here I was about to pay off another twenty thousand won for you.
You are way too stiff and serious. A variety producer needs a touch of playful B-grade humor.
Keep that in mind, got it?
Actually, those slang words are old Japanese holdovers, so I do not think producers should use them.
The first term means serious and proper, while the second means funny and lowbrow.
